strategies.description: `by exact X` is a tactic wrapper around a term that needs none — use the term directly.

example.before: theorem foo : P := by exact h

strategies.caveat: Keep `by exact` when the elaborator needs the tactic block to postpone unification — if the term form fails to elaborate, revert.
`by rfl` and `rfl` can differ in reducibility settings; if the term form fails, the tactic was doing real work.

strategies.description: `unfold f; simp [...]` folds into a single `simp [f, ...]`.
`unfold f; rw [h₁, h₂]` folds into `simp [f, h₁, h₂]`.
strategies.caveat: NOT equivalent in general: `rw` rewrites left-to-right once at the first match, `simp` rewrites to normal form. Can close goals `rw` would leave open, or loop where `rw` terminated. Verify the build before accepting.

strategies.description: `have h := foo; linarith` passes the fact directly: `linarith [foo]`.
strategies.caveat: Only when `h` is used once. A reused `have` is a legibility gain, not a redundancy.

strategies.description: `have h := foo; exact h` is an indirection — `exact foo`.
`apply f; apply g x` composes into `exact f (g x)`.
strategies.caveat: `apply` postpones metavariables; the composed term may need explicit arguments the tactic chain inferred.

strategies.description: `@Zero.zero T inst.toZero` is the elaborator's output, not something to write — use `(0 : T)`.
A theorem whose entire content is restating a structure field should be deleted; use the field directly.

example.after: -- deleted; use `d.claim` at the use sites

strategies.caveat: Overlaps `proof-no-self-assuming-projection`, which treats this as a CRITICAL vacuity defect rather than a tidiness win. Route through `lean-proof-review` first — if the field IS the goal, the problem is the statement, not its length.

strategies.description: `rw [retraction]; rfl` on a coerced function application has a direct term form.
strategies.caveat: DFunLike is Mathlib-version sensitive — this was FunLike before the Mathlib rename. Re-verify the bound before applying on an older pin.

strategies.description: Duplicate docstrings on a structure field: keep the latest.
